facts.claim: PostHog has two parallel Temporal workflows implementing task sandbox execution with duplicated logic: process_task/workflow.py (ProcessTaskWorkflow, legacy, supports continue_as_new via ResumedSandboxState) and execute_sandbox/workflow.py (ExecuteSandboxWorkflow, newer per-sandbox child workflow coordinated by TaskManagementWorkflow); execute_sandbox is explicitly a duplicate of process_task pending a later deletion of process_task.
